passages.reference:
तदुदीर्णं महत् सैन्यं त्रैलोक्यस्यापि संजय।
भयमुत्पादयेत् तीव्रं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥ ११॥
passages.transcription:
तदुदीर्णं महत् सैन्यं त्रैलोक्यस्यापि संजय।
भयमुत्पादयेत्तु तीव्रं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥११॥

passages.reference:
को हि दौर्योधने सैन्ये पुमानासीन्महारथः।
यं प्राप्य समरे वीरा न त्रस्यन्ति महाभये॥ १२॥
passages.transcription:
को हि दुर्योधने सैन्ये पुमानासीन्महारथः।
यं प्राप्य समरे वीरा न त्रस्यन्ति महाभये॥१२॥

passages.reference:
Verily, O Sanjaya, the innumerable and
excellent army of the high-souled sons of
Pandu, can strike the worlds with keenest
apprehension. In this terrific battle, was any
great car-warrior in the troop of Duryodhana
who was feerless?
passages.transcription:
Verily, O Sanjaya, the innumerable and
excellent army of the high-souled sons of
Pandu, can strike the worlds with keenest
apprehension. In this terrific battle, was any
great car-warrior in the troop of Duryodhana
who was fearless?

passages.reference: संजय उवाच
passages.transcription: संजय उवाच

passages.reference:
देवव्रते तु निहते कुरूणामृषभे तदा।
किमकार्षुर्नृपतयस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥ १३॥
passages.transcription:
देवव्रते तु निहते कुरूणामृषभे तदा।
किमकार्षुर्नृपतयस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥१३॥

passages.reference: Sanjaya said
passages.transcription: Sanjaya said

passages.reference:
Therefore, O Sanjaya, recount to me what
the kings did, when Devarata, the foremost of
the Kurus, had been slain.
passages.transcription:
Therefore, O Sanjaya, recount to me what
the kings did, when Devarata, the foremost of
the Kurus, had been slain.

passages.reference:
शृणु राजन्नेकमना वचनं ब्रुवतो मम।
यत् ते पुत्रास्तदाऽकार्षुर्हते देवव्रते मृधे॥ १४॥
passages.transcription:
शृणु राजन्नेकमना वचनं ब्रुवतो मम।
यत्ते पुत्रास्तदाकार्षुर्हते देवव्रते मृधे॥१४॥

passages.reference:
Hear, O monarch, with singleness of mind,
the words, falling from my lips, regarding what
your sons did when Devavrata had fallen.
passages.transcription:
Hear, O monarch, with singleness of mind,
the words, falling from my lips, regarding what
your sons did when Devavrata had fallen.

passages.reference:
निहते तु तदा भीष्मे राजन् सत्यपराक्रमे।
तावकाः पाण्डवेयाश्च प्राध्यायन्त पृथक् पृथक्॥ १५॥
passages.transcription:
निहते तु तदा भीष्मे राजन् सत्यपराक्रमे।
तावकाः पाण्डवेयाश्च प्राध्यायन्त पृथक् पृथक्॥१५॥

passages.reference:
O monarch, when Bhishma of invincible
prowess had been slain, your own warriors and
also those of the Pandava host, began to think
of the duties of the Kshatriya sect; and,
passages.transcription:
O monarch, when Bhishma of invincible
prowess had been slain, your own warriors and
also those of the Pandava host, began to think
of the duties of the Kshatriya sect; and,

passages.reference:
विस्मिताश्च प्रहृष्टाश्च क्षत्रधर्मं निशम्य ते।
स्वधर्मं निन्दमानास्ते प्रणिपत्य महात्मने॥ १६॥
passages.transcription:
विस्मिताश्च प्रहृष्टाश्च क्षत्रधर्मं निशम्य ते।
स्वधर्मं निन्दमानास्ते प्रणिपत्य महात्मने॥१६॥

passages.reference:
शयनं कल्पयामासुर्भीष्मायामितकर्मणे।
सोपधानं नरव्याघ्र शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ १७॥
passages.transcription:
शयनं कल्पयामासुर्भीष्मायामितकर्मणे।
सोपधानं नरव्याघ्र शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥१७॥

passages.reference:
O lord of men, at the thought, they
wondered and were delighted; and in
obedience to their sectarian duties, they bowed
down to the illustrious Bhishma. Then those
foremost of men prepared for Bhishma of
infinite energy a bed furnished with a pillow,
made of close-knotted arrows.
passages.transcription:
O lord of men, at the thought, they
wondered and were delighted; and in
obedience to their sectarian duties, they bowed
down to the illustrious Bhishma. Then those
foremost of men prepared for Bhishma of
infinite energy a bed furnished with a pillow,
made of close-knotted arrows.

passages.reference:
विधाय रक्षां भीष्माय समाभाष्य परस्परम्।
अनुमान्य च गाङ्गेयं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ १८॥
passages.transcription:
विधाय रक्षां भीष्माय समाभाष्य परस्परम्।
अनुमान्य च गाङ्गेयं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥१८॥

passages.reference: MAHĀBHĀRATA
passages.transcription: MAHĀBHĀRATA

passages.reference:
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनाः समवेत्य परस्परम्।
पुनर्युद्धाय निर्जग्मुः क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः॥ १९॥
passages.transcription:
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनाः समेत्य परस्परम्।
पुनर्युद्धाय निर्ययुः क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः॥१९॥

passages.reference:
Having arranged for Bhishma’s safety and
having greeted one another, and with the
permission of the son of Ganga and having
circumambulated him and looking at each
other with eyes coppery with anger, those
Kshatriyas, goaded by Destiny, again issued
forth for fighting with one another.
passages.transcription:
Having arranged for Bhishma’s safety and
having greeted one another, and with the
permission of the son of Ganga and having
circumambulated him and looking at each
other with eyes coppery with anger, those
Kshatriyas, goaded by Destiny, again issued
forth for fighting with one another.

passages.reference:
ततस्तूर्यनिनादैश्च भेरीणां निनदेन च।
तावकानामनीकानि परेषां च विनिर्ययुः॥ २०॥
passages.transcription:
ततः शङ्खनिनादैश्च भेरीणां निनदेन च।
तावकानामनीकानि परेषां च विनिर्ययुः॥२०॥

passages.reference:
Then to the voice of the trumpets and to the
roar of the drums, the army of your sons and
that of their adversaries, formed in battle-array.
passages.transcription:
Then to the voice of the trumpets and to the
roar of the drums, the army of your sons and
that of their adversaries, formed in battle-array.

passages.reference:
व्यावृत्तेऽर्यम्णि राजेन्द्र पतिते जाह्नवीसुते।
अमर्षवशमापन्नाः कालोपहतचेतसः॥ २१॥
passages.transcription:
व्यावृत्तेऽह्नि राजेन्द्र पतिते जाह्नवीसुते।
अमर्षवशमापन्नाः कालोपहतचेतसः॥२१॥

passages.reference:
अनादृत्य वचः पथ्यं गाङ्गेयस्य महात्मनः।
निर्ययुर्भरतश्रेष्ठाः शस्त्राण्यादाय सत्वराः॥ २२॥
passages.transcription:
अनादृत्य वचः पथ्यं गाङ्गेयस्य महात्मनः।
निर्ययुर्भरतश्रेष्ठाः शस्त्राण्यादाय सत्वराः॥२२॥

passages.reference:
When, O greatest of kings, the son of
Janhavi (Bhishma) had fallen and when the
greater part of the day had worn out, these
foremost of the Bharata race, overpowered by
the influence of their wrath, and having their
reasons bewildered through fate and neglecting
the salutary counsel of the illustrious son of
Ganga, came out in haste grasping their
weapons.
passages.transcription:
When, O greatest of kings, the son of
Janhavi (Bhishma) had fallen and when the
greater part of the day had worn out, these
foremost of the Bharata race, overpowered by
the influence of their wrath, and having their
reasons bewildered through fate and neglecting
the salutary counsel of the illustrious son of
Ganga, came out in haste grasping their
weapons.

passages.reference:
मोहात् तव सपुत्रस्य वधाच्छान्तनवस्य च।
कौरव्या मृत्युसाद्भूताः सहिताः सर्वराजभिः॥ २३॥
passages.transcription:
मोहात् तव सपुत्रस्य वधाच्छान्तनवस्य च।
कौरव्या मृत्युसाद्भूताः सहिताः सर्वराजभिः॥२३॥

passages.reference:
Owing to your own foolishness and that of
your sons and owing to the death of the son of
Shantanu, the descendants of the Kuru race
together with all the (assembled) kings,
appeared to be summoned by the God of death.
passages.transcription:
Owing to your own foolishness and that of
your sons and owing to the death of the son of
Shantanu, the descendants of the Kuru race
together with all the (assembled) kings,
appeared to be summoned by the God of death.

passages.reference:
अजावय इवागोपा वने श्वापदसंकुले।
भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो हीना देवव्रतेन ते॥ २४॥
passages.transcription:
अजावय इवागोपा वने श्वापदसंकुले।
भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो हीना देवव्रतेन ते॥२४॥

passages.reference:
Like a herd of goats without a herdsman in
wood infested with beasts of prey, they were
exceedingly oppressed with fear, being
deprived of Devavrata.
passages.transcription:
Like a herd of goats without a herdsman in
wood infested with beasts of prey, they were
exceedingly oppressed with fear, being
deprived of Devavrata.

passages.reference:
पतिते भरतश्रेष्ठे बभूव कुरुवाहिनी।
द्यौरिवापेतनक्षत्रा हीनं खमिव वायुना॥ २५॥
passages.transcription:
पतिते भरतश्रेष्ठे बभूव कुरुवाहिनी।
द्यौरिवापेतनक्षत्रा हीनं खमिव वायुना॥२५॥
